name: Nachos Platter

ingredients.name: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Preheat oven to 200°C. Heat oil in a small pan, add beans, cumin, water and 1 g salt; simmer for 5 minutes until hot with little free liquid.
Dice tomato and onion finely. Mix with chopped coriander, 15 ml lime juice and remaining 2 g salt; drain any pooled liquid.
Mash avocado coarsely with remaining 10 ml lime juice. Keep sour cream and drained jalapenos ready.
Spread half the chips on an ovenproof platter, add half the beans and cheese, then repeat. Bake for 8 minutes until cheese melts and the chips are hot.
Top with drained salsa, jalapenos and spoonfuls of avocado and sour cream. Serve immediately so the chips stay crisp.
tips: Choose sturdy plain chips and add all cold, wet toppings after baking.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
